articles.title: Week 14 fantasy football RB rankings: Best starts at running back
articles.summary: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers offense faces significant challenges due to numerous player injuries. These substantial personnel issues are significantly impacting the team's strategic execution and overall performance, posing hurdles for their season.

articles.title: Modi-Putin meeting sets course for next-gen India–Russia defence ties
articles.summary: India and Russia are transforming their long-standing defence partnership from a buyer-seller relationship to one focused on joint research, development, and co-production. This strategic shift aims to enhance India's indigenous defence manufacturing capabilities and self-reliance (Atmanirbhar Bharat), strengthening both nations' security interests and technological collaboration in the defence sector.

articles.title: Frank Gehry, the most celebrated architect of his time, dies at 96
articles.summary: Renowned architect Frank Gehry, celebrated globally for his groundbreaking and imaginative building designs, has passed away at 96. Gehry achieved an exceptional level of worldwide acclaim, leaving an indelible mark on modern architecture. His innovative structures redefined urban landscapes and artistic sensibilities, making his death a significant event for the design world.
